item.title: Asking Eric: Stepmom goes to great lengths to avoid ‘useless’ stepson
item.description: A stepmother is at her breaking point after learning her husband's son is moving in permanently. Asking Eric discusses marriage, boundaries, and the reality of blended families. Also, advice for a couple struggling with guests who brought alcohol into their sober home.

item.title: Today in History: ‘Bloody Sunday’ in Selma for civil rights movement
item.description: On March 7, 1965, a march by over 500 civil rights demonstrators was violently broken up at the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma, Alabama; state troopers and a sheriff’s posse fired tear gas and beat marchers with batons in what became known as “Bloody Sunday.”

item.title: Colorado lawmakers want to carve a new path out of prison in second-look sentencing bill
item.description: Colorado lawmakers are considering whether to carve a new path out of prison for some inmates who have served at least two decades behind bars.

item.title: After police funding initiative passed, Colorado lawmakers want voters to know the cost of some ballot questions
item.description: The proposal is aimed at ballot measures that seek to increase state spending without an attached funding source, such as a tax increase.
